data.name: Abra
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'abr' (to be a father of), Abra is a name for a woman who is the mother of numerous offspring. In Islamic history, Abra is mentioned as the wife of Prophet Ibrahim (Abraham), the matriarch of the Hebrew people.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes motherhood, nurturing, and the abundance of blessings.
